# GENERATED FILE -- do not hand-edit.
#
# The exact, resolved dependency set `requirements.txt` produced when this
# file was last regenerated, consumed by the Dockerfile as
# `pip install -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt` (dependency audit
# PIN-11). `requirements.txt` stays the human file -- floors, ceilings and
# the reasons for them; this file is the pinned, diff-reviewable ceiling on
# every package pip resolves from it, direct and transitive alike, so two
# builds of the same commit install the same versions.
#
# Regenerate with a THROWAWAY venv (never the shared dev `.venv`, and never
# a venv borrowed from another session's worktree). `LC_ALL=C` pins the sort
# order to plain byte values regardless of the machine's locale, so the
# same requirements.txt always regenerates byte-identical output:
#
#   python3.12 -m venv /tmp/constraints-venv
#   /tmp/constraints-venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
#   /tmp/constraints-venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
#   /tmp/constraints-venv/bin/pip freeze --exclude-editable | LC_ALL=C sort -f > constraints.txt
#
# Then restore this header (freeze does not write one) and commit
# requirements.txt and constraints.txt together -- see docs/DEV.md
# "Bumping a dependency".
#
# KNOWN GAP: this set includes pytest and pytest-asyncio --
# llama-index-embeddings-ollama requires pytest-asyncio unconditionally,
# not as an extra, so both land in the production image regardless of the
# requirements.txt/requirements-dev.txt split (dependency audit IMAGE-7).
# See docs/DEV.md "Bumping a dependency" and
# foundation/ops/tests/test_repo_hygiene.py::
# test_the_constraints_file_carries_no_test_toolchain (xfail, strict).
